body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2Lof3BCv5rxW9qPdtyr7VJs)_

## Merge order

- Based on `main`; no hard dependency. Main was merged into the branch on 2026-11-15 (conflicts resolved, see below).
- **#437 (crossref resolver, merged)**: `sp-devonthink-record` is kept; this PR replaces the offset arithmetic in `sp-devonthink-resolve` with the PDF page-label lookup. The offset steps in #437's Manual testing (`sp-devonthink-parent-page-offsets`) no longer apply.
- **#436** (merged): this PR removes `sp-devonthink-page-offset`, `sp-devonthink-parent-page-offsets` and `sp-devonthink-first-page` that #436 added.
- **#419 (merged)**: the ADR is now **0033** (0032 became the reading-database ADR) and is in the `adr/README.org` table.
- **#500**: the doc is now `docs/tangles/devonthink/sp-devonthink.org`; the page-label edits were ported there and the `.el` re-tangled from it.
- #435, #434: not touched.

## Why

- Sia: the printed-to-physical page information should live in the PDF itself, not in Emacs or the record. Page labels (`/PageLabels`) are the PDF's own way to say "physical page 1 is 360".
- Decision and alternatives: `adr/0033-page-labels-live-in-the-pdf.org`. Nothing is implemented inside DEVONthink (no metadata, no AppleScript).

## Change

- Literate doc `docs/tangles/academic/pdf-page-labels.org` tangles to `tools/pdf_page_labels.py` (library), three tools and `tests/test_pdf_page_labels.py`.
- `tools/pdf-labels-articles.py` (batch): dry run unless `--apply`.
  - Handles `article`, `inproceedings`, `conference`, `suppperiodical` with no `crossref`/`xref` (`--types` widens it); skips and reports `book`, `collection`, `incollection`, `inbook`, theses, reports and the rest.
  - First page of `pages`: `360--364`, `360-364`, `e123` (label `e123`), `xii--xv` (roman), upper-case roman; anything else is skipped with the reason.
  - Skips a PDF that already has different labels unless `--force`; reports unchanged ones; warns when the page range length differs from the PDF's page count.
  - Options: `--only KEY`, `--bib`, `--bib-dir`, `--library`, `--backup-dir`, `--verbose`.
- `tools/pdf-labels-book.py CITEKEY-OR-PDF --first-page N [--front-roman ...]`: one book, never reads `pages`; dry run unless `--apply`.
- Writing is safe: save to a temp file, re-open and check page count and labels, copy the original to `~/.local/state/pdf-page-labels/backups/TIMESTAMP/...`, then replace.
- `tools/pdf-labels-read.py FILE --resolve LABEL`: the reader Emacs calls (exit 3 no labels, 4 not found).
- `sp-devonthink`: `sp-devonthink-first-page-label`, `sp-devonthink-pdf-page-for-label`, options `sp-devonthink-label-command` and `sp-devonthink-label-script`; the two offset options are removed. With no labels or no match, the parent opens at the start with a message saying why.
- Needs `pikepdf` (`pip install pikepdf`); each tool also has a `uv run` inline dependency. qpdf alone is not enough for lookup.
- No CHANGELOG edits.

## What was verified and what was not

- [x] 29 Python tests (`python3 -m unittest tests/test_pdf_page_labels.py`) on generated PDFs: parsing, BibTeX reader, round trip, backup, failed save leaves the original, both tools in dry run and `--apply`, the reader's exit codes.
- [x] After the merge with main: 45 ERT tests in `sp-devonthink-test.el` pass (one runs the real reader script on a generated PDF); the browse, tags, highlights, sync and bibsync suites still pass; no conflict markers.
- **DEVONthink page counting (from documentation, not run):**
  - [DEVONtechnologies forum](https://discourse.devontechnologies.com/t/x-devonthink-item-link-from-pdf-expert-with-page-number/55617): a staff reply says the `page` parameter of an item link is zero-based.
  - [DEVONthink blog](https://www.devontechnologies.com/blog/20220208-pdf-page-numbering): copied page links point at the page number, not the folio; `?page=12` opens physical page 13.
  - This matches the existing code (`?page=N-1`) and the `sp-litdb` measurement.
- **Not checked:**
  - whether DEVONthink shows or uses the PDF's page labels in its own page display or links (the docs I found don't say; the code assumes links stay physical);
  - the base of `current page` in AppleScript (still `sp-devonthink-store-page-offset`);
  - `pikepdf` on the Mac, `python3` there being one that has it, and any real PDF of yours (everything ran on generated PDFs on Linux);
  - the `file` field forms in your real `.bib` files beyond relative paths, `JabRef` triples and name lookup; entries that only have `bdsk-file-N` are not found.

## Manual testing

- [ ] `pip install pikepdf` (or note the `uv run` route), then `tools/pdf-labels-articles.py --only KEY` for one journal article: a dry run lists `would-label KEY ... first page 360` and writes nothing.
- [ ] Same with `--apply --only KEY`: the PDF opens in Preview or DEVONthink with pages 360 to 364 shown; a copy of the original is under `~/.local/state/pdf-page-labels/backups/`.
- [ ] Run it again: reported `unchanged`.
- [ ] `tools/pdf-labels-articles.py` for the whole library, dry run: read the skip reasons (no PDF, unparseable pages, several PDFs); check the warnings about page ranges that differ from the PDF length.
- [ ] Entry with `pages = {e123}` and one with `xii--xv`: labels `e123, e124, ...` and `xii, xiii, ...`.
- [ ] A `book` and an `incollection` entry are not touched.
- [ ] Book whose printed page 1 is the 9th PDF page: `tools/pdf-labels-book.py KEY --first-page 9 --front-roman` (dry run), then `--apply`; the viewer shows i to viii and then 1.
- [ ] A chapter of that book in citar, `embark-act` then `D`: DEVONthink opens the book at the chapter's first page; the echo area says `from the PDF's page labels`.
- [ ] If it opens one page off, say which way: DEVONthink may be counting differently than the docs say.
- [ ] A chapter whose parent PDF has no labels: opens at the start; the message says to run `pdf-labels-book.py`.
- [ ] If the message says it could not read the labels, check `(setq sp-devonthink-label-command '("uv" "run" "--script"))` or a Python that has `pikepdf`.
- [ ] Check that DEVONthink still finds and opens a PDF after it was labelled (the file's bytes changed).

## Revert guide

- Restore a PDF: copy the file from `~/.local/state/pdf-page-labels/backups/TIMESTAMP/<original path>` over it. To remove the labels instead, run `tools/pdf-labels-book.py KEY --first-page 1 --apply`, which writes plain `1, 2, 3, ...`.
- Revert the code: `git revert` the PR's commits (the original commit and the merge-fix commit). That restores the offset options and `sp-devonthink-first-page` from #436; the tools and the ADR go away. PDFs already labelled keep their labels, which are harmless to other programs.

commit.message:
✨ Write PDF page labels and read them to open chapters in a book's PDF

- Add tools/pdf-labels-articles.py (batch, from the BibTeX pages field) and tools/pdf-labels-book.py (one book, by hand), both dry run by default with a backup before writing.
- Add tools/pdf-labels-read.py; sp-devonthink asks it which PDF page has the chapter's first printed page.
- Remove sp-devonthink-page-offset and sp-devonthink-parent-page-offsets.
- Add ADR 0032 and the literate doc pdf-page-labels.org.
